summary: Frontend-only test for Robot Boogie game + disco/curtain visual refresh. All 4 CREATE tiles render (jam-session, beat-lab, robot-boogie, song-studio). Robot Boogie page loads with all 11 required data-testids present exactly once. All 8 characters render in a single row (bounding-box y range = 0.0 px on 1280x900). Initial state 0/8 with data-active=false. Tap Charlie -> 1/8 + data-active=true. Chunk 4-cycle test: taps 1-4 keep data-active=true and count stays at 2/8; tap 5 flips to false and count drops to 1/8. Reset returns count to 0/8 and all chars to neutral. Asset regression: all 31 URLs (12 mp3s + 19 images incl. jmatv-logo.png at 244,169 bytes ~238KB) return HTTP 200 with non-zero content-length. Lessons page uses curtain-bg.png with charlie-lecturn overlay; all 7 lesson names present. /boom-garden uses jukebox-floor-1.png, has 'Who' title, 'Pick your jam' subtitle, PARROT PERCUSSION / BEAT FINDER / RHYTHM RUN modes, and NO 'Echo Stew'. /rhythm-game has JELLY JUKEBOX title with jelly-jukebox-scene.png bg. /jmatv shows 4 channel tiles. Blimp present on /play /learn /create. No PAGEERROR events. Only console errors observed were 401s on backend endpoints (unrelated to this frontend-only feature).
critical_code_review_comments: All 12 robot-boogie audio stems return identical content-length (440,696 bytes) — worth a manual audio-content spot check to confirm each stem is a distinct file rather than a duplicated placeholder. Test requirement (HTTP 200 + non-zero CL) is satisfied either way.

The word 'channel' still appears inside a CSS/JS source comment served in the DOM (JMAtv channel pages) — not visible copy so not a regression, but worth cleaning up if a full purge of the term is desired.

The test/task description referenced testid `submenu-tile-charlies-song-studio`, but actual testid derived from tile id is `submenu-tile-song-studio`. Not a bug — task description was slightly off. All 4 tiles render correctly.
seed_data_creation: localStorage jma_player_v1 + jma_player_name_skipped_v1 and sessionStorage jma_audio_unlocked_v1 set to bypass welcome + audio-unlock modals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HashRouter app. To bypass modals: after first goto to origin, evaluate: localStorage.setItem('jma_player_v1', JSON.stringify({id:'local',displayName:'Tester',createdAt:new Date().toISOString()})); localStorage.setItem('jma_player_name_skipped_v1','1'); sessionStorage.setItem('jma_audio_unlocked_v1','1'); then reload. add_init_script alone was NOT sufficient — welcome modal still appeared on first fresh load. Robot Boogie testids: robot-boogie-page, robot-boogie-time-machine, robot-boogie-active-count, robot-boogie-reset, robot-boogie-char-{finn,chunk,charlie,jazzy,jellybone,lou,robot1,robot2}. Chunk cycles 4 drum stems then off on 5th tap. Dr. Jellybone cycles 2 horn stems then off on 3rd tap.
